name: Article 3, § 1 – 6
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: 1. The Union shall prioritise the strengthening of public services, the protection of social rights and the reduction of territorial inequalities, in particular in its least-developed regions. In responding to the conflict in Ukraine, it shall give priority to the protection of civilians, humanitarian assistance and sustained diplomatic efforts aimed at bringing hostilities to an end.
